Name: PierreDatable
Author: totoroo678678
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Makes Pierre a single and datable NPC in Stardew Valley. Now you can romance, marry, and live with the owner of the General Store. Pierre’s schedule remains unchanged, and he still runs his shop after marriage. Compatible with most visual mods (portraits, sprites, seasonal outfits).

[b]Installation instructions[/b]

1. Install Content Patcher (if not already installed).
2. Download this mod and unzip it to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Launch the game and enjoy.

[b]Main features[/b]

· Pierre becomes dateable (hearts up to 10, bouquet event).
· You can propose with the Mermaid Pendant and marry Pierre.
· After marriage, Pierre moves to your farm and has new spouse dialogue.
· Pierre stays single — his original marriage to Caroline is ignored (no divorce events, Caroline stays in town).
· No changes to Pierre’s schedule or shop hours.

[b]Requirements[/b]

· Content Patcher (latest version).
· (Optional) PolyamorySweet — if you want to marry Pierre while already married to someone else.
· (Optional) Any visual mod for Pierre — fully compatible.

[b]Shout outs
[/b]
· ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley.
· Pathoschild for Content Patcher.
· Google AI for helping with code and dialogue structure.
